def display_result_ai(result_id):
    from pathlib import Path
    import re
    safe_id = re.sub('[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]', '-', result_id).strip('.')
    note = Path('../data/ai_interpretations/en') / f'{safe_id}.md'
    if note.is_file() and (not note.is_symlink()):
        display(Markdown(note.read_text(encoding='utf-8')))
